title: dForge Module Export Templates
description: Excel export template declarations for a dForge module package (ui/export_templates.json). Each key is the template_cd; the value binds an .xlsx file under export_templates/ to an entity. A user picks it from the grid's Export menu, and data.export with that template pours the entity's rows into the workbook: a cell {{rows.column_cd}} repeats once per row, {{_count}} is the row count and {{_today}} today's date.

entityCd.description: Entity code whose rows the template receives. Cross-module form 'module.entity' is supported.

description.description: Label shown in the Export menu. Defaults to the template code.

file.description: Relative path of the .xlsx under the module's export_templates/ directory (e.g. 'invoices.xlsx').
